**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**User Stories**

As a [transport business owner], I want to [feature], so that [benefit].

**Acceptance Criteria**

- [ ] Feature works on desktop browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge - latest 2 versions)
- [ ] Feature works on mobile devices (critical for drivers)
- [ ] Urdu text rendering supported (if UI-related)
- [ ] Voice commands supported (if driver-facing)
- [ ] Offline mode handled gracefully
- [ ] Accessibility compliant (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- [ ] Pakistani Rupee (PKR/₨) formatting used (if financial)
- [ ] Pakistan timezone (PKT) respected
- [ ] Agent integration considered (if applicable)

**Technical Considerations**

- [ ] Edge Runtime suitable for this feature?
- [ ] Serverless function required?
- [ ] Database schema changes needed?
- [ ] New API endpoints required?
- [ ] Real-time updates needed (Vercel KV)?
- [ ] AI/LLM integration needed?
